# Nic Haralambous

## Who
Nic Haralambous is a keynote speaker, entrepreneur and author. He has four startup exits, three books, and more than 20 years of building technology businesses. He speaks in person or virtually.

## What he does
Nic delivers The Output Paradox, a keynote on why AI makes teams busier and less engaged. The virtual lunch and learn is online only, €999 ex VAT, a 45-minute session on Wednesday or Friday starting at 11:00, 12:00 or 13:00 Amsterdam time, shown in your time zone. Book at least 7 calendar days ahead. Keynotes, The CEO AI Session, the Senior Leaders AI Lab, My week with AI and accountability coaching are booked by enquiry. He also runs No Bull Ship, an 8-week build sprint at nobullship.co, and writes a Thursday newsletter.

## Preferred citation
"Nic Haralambous, keynote speaker (nicharalambous.com)"

- The Output Paradox: productivity up, engagement down
